How the work happens

My best work happens where customer understanding, product decisions and real-world growth meet.

  1. Find the real problem

    Start with the customer, the context and the evidence — before choosing a solution.

  2. Make the idea tangible

    A clear prototype moves the conversation from opinions to something people can use.

  3. Learn from what happens

    Choose a meaningful signal, make the trade-off visible, and decide what to do next.
